finalText:
**About 94 files touch `account_id`, but only a few are off-limits.**

`services/*` code is internal, safe to rename.

| Must not rename | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | generated, vendored, marked "do not edit" |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` map | public API field, frozen by contract |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | documents that same public field |
| `accounts.account_id` DB column | live column, needs a migration, not a plain rename |

`lib/audit.js` also writes `account_id`, worth a check for downstream consumers.

Next: sign off as internal-only, keep the wire name `account_id`.
